title: 第一卷 第7章 妖奴第一卷 第8章 还有没有了
lines: 秦烈的身影消失在光门里后，院子里的光门也慢慢缩回了百妖鉴之中。
铜镜悬在石桌上方，镜面泛着一层灰白色的光。
上面能够清晰地看到秦烈在里面的画面。
陆沉看了一眼镜面，开口道：“你们觉得，他能闯到第几关？”
李虎抱着膀子，想都没想就笑了一声。
“第一关都悬。”
“百妖鉴里的那些妖物虽然都是法器演化出来的，但是第一次进去的人根本分不清真假。”
“他以前又是个脑子不清楚的，这种情况下，肯定是过不了第一关的。”
陆沉看了他一眼。
“我记得你第一次进百妖鉴的时候，也只过了第一关。”
李虎脸上的笑僵了一下。
“老大，好端端的，你提我干什么？”
陆沉淡淡道：“只是提醒你，他要是过了第一关，潜力就跟你一样了，你再喊他傻子，那你自己也成傻子了。”
许青禾站在旁边，轻声道：“李虎那次第一关过得也不轻松，出来的时候，腿还抖了半天。”
李虎顿时瞪了她一眼。
“许青禾，你不说话没人当你哑巴。”
许青禾没有理他。
李虎咳了一声，强行把话题拉了回来。
“我那是第一次没经验。”
“再说了，我好歹也过了第一关。”
李虎说到这里，差点又把“傻子”两个字说出来。
不过想到刚才老大说的话，他硬生生把话又咽回去了。
“这小子怎么可能跟我一样过第一关？”
陆沉看着镜面，忽然笑了笑。
“我倒觉得，他能过第一关。”
“老大，你真这么看好他？”
“赌不赌？”
一听到陆沉说要打赌，李虎就来了精神。
“赌什么？”
陆沉道：“他要是过了第一关，三个月之内，你不许喝酒。”
李虎脸色一变。
“老大，这也太狠了吧？”
陆沉道：“你是不是不敢呀？”
李虎立刻拍了拍胸口。
“谁不敢了？赌就赌。”
“他要是能过第一关，我三个月不喝酒。”
“但他要是连第一关都过不了，老大你藏的那坛十年陈酿可得归我。”
content_en:
After Qin Lie's figure disappeared into the light gate, the light gate in the courtyard slowly retracted into the Baiyao Jian.
The bronze mirror hung above the stone table, and the mirror surface glowed with a layer of gray-white light.
You can clearly see Qin Lie inside.
Lu Chen looked at his face and said, "How high do you think he can get?"
Li Hu hugged his arms and laughed without thinking.
"The first hurdle is hanging."
"Although the monsters in the Hundred Demons' Book are all evolved from magic weapons, people who enter for the first time can't tell the real ones from the fake ones."
"He was a confused person before. In this case, he will definitely not be able to pass the first level."
Lu Chen glanced at him.
"I remember that the first time you entered the Baiyaojian, you only passed the first level."
The smile on Li Hu's face froze.
"Boss, you're so good, why are you mentioning me?"
Lu Chen said calmly: "I'm just reminding you that if he passes the first level, his potential will be the same as yours. If you call him a fool again, you will become a fool yourself."
Xu Qinghe stood nearby and said softly: "Li Hu didn't pass the first test easily that time. When he came out, his legs were shaking for a long time."
Li Hu immediately glared at her.
"Xu Qinghe, if you don't speak, no one will think you are dumb."
Xu Qinghe ignored him.
Li Hu coughed and forcibly brought the topic back.
"It was my first time and I had no experience."
"Besides, I finally passed the first level."
"This is stupid..."
When Li Hu said this, he almost said the word "fool" again.
But thinking of what the boss said just now, he swallowed it back.
"How can this kid pass the first level like me?"
Lu Chen looked at the mirror and suddenly smiled.
"I think he can pass the first level."
"Boss, do you really think so highly of him?"
"Bet or not?"
Li Hu perked up as soon as he heard Lu Chen said he wanted to make a bet.
"What bet?"
Lu Chen said: "If he passes the first level, you are not allowed to drink alcohol within three months."
Li Hu's expression changed.
"Boss, isn't this too cruel?"
Lu Chen said: "Don't you dare?"
Li Hu immediately patted his chest.
"Who doesn't dare? Just bet."
"If he can pass the first level, I won't drink for three months."
"But if he can't even pass the first level, boss, the jar of ten-year-old wine you have hidden will be mine."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 7 Demon Slave Volume 1 Chapter 8 Is there any more?
